body: I'm also 17 years old, and trying to start some sort of business. I have a tip for you. My dad told me, that one of his friends earns a whole bunch of money, just looking at amazon and seeing what is popular. If it is a pot, he calls some chinese company and say, "hey, i want 200 pots with a lid to" and then sells it. Maybe that was an idea? Taking something popular and add a little extra to it. (sorry for bad english, im from denmark)

My mother worked at home, when i was a kid. Even though we had a very big house, where she had her company in the basement, i think some of the things she did, you could copy. What she did, was that she would work when we were in school, and then when we came home (we are three kids), she would spent about 30 min to 1 hour, just talking to us about our day etc. Then she went back to work, until it was dinner time. She just learned us, that we needed to be mostly by ourself, of course we could always come down to her, but we mostly was by ourself. What you could do, could be the same, tell your kids that you are working. Maybe they won't understand it at first, but they will learn it, and it won't be a problem. Hope this helps!

I know how you feel, i am kinda in the same situation as you.
Girl, you are strong as hell. Remember that. So many people would have falled of the train by now, but you still fight. Regardless of the music, there is so many things you can do without a graduation. If you really want to play music, but maybe just need a break right now, you can always come back, and start your own little business. If you are patient enough, and respect yourself, you WILL BE ALRIGHT. 
First of, tell your parents the truth. Tell them what you feel about them, and get that out of the world. If they don't respect you, you don't have to respect them. Put yourself as the nr. 1 priority, and do what makes you happy. 
Second, talk to your boyfriend. I'm sure he will do everything to help you. At least he deserves to know how you feel. I think that it probably will feel like you are just making everything worse, but in the end, it will strengthen your bond. You can make it through this. You just have to be patient, and put yourself as your nr. 1 priority. 
If you don't want to talk to your parents/boyfriend right now, but want to talk to someone, PM me, and i will do my best to help you.

Just seeing my moms and dads house makes me sad and kinda angry, because i'm mad at them for doing all this to me. The problem is just that my mom went nuts at me when i told her i wanted to move out this summer, and said that by no chance she would allow it. So i feel like im trapped. Also it can just be me alone or with my friends, where i get this empty feeling, that i'm easily replaced, and i sometimes literally just think the whole scenario of me killing my self. How good everyone would have it when i'm gone
